entries.claim: Scala 3 enum and sealed ADT forms provide closed stable identifiers with exhaustive matching.
entries.problemRelevance: Represents stable error codes, function identifiers, and result variants without open strings inside the core.
entries.correctnessRisk: JSON spelling and exhaustive mapping can drift from the neutral registry.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Supported by Scala 3.8.4 and the frozen stable compiler profile.
requiredLint: Exhaustive match and no unused enum case under the frozen hard-warning profile.
requiredTests: Registry-to-enum exact-set equality and every variant round-trip.
requiredBenchmark: No independent performance claim; include in full native correctness subject.
entries.provenFallback: A sealed trait with final case objects and an exact registry mapping.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Public Scala language reference; no source code copied into the candidate.
assumptions: The neutral JSON registry remains the public source of exact spellings.

entries.claim: Opaque types can make validated probability and bounded-count boundaries distinct without wrapping every numeric intermediate.
entries.problemRelevance: Prevents accidental interchange of confidence, significance, and exact count domains.
entries.correctnessRisk: Over-wrapping kernel intermediates could obscure IEEE-754 parity or add conversion paths.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Stable in Scala 3.8.4 and compatible with MUnit and Scalafix.
requiredLint: Smart constructors are the only public creation path and no unchecked cast unwraps a value.
requiredTests: Boundary, lexical integer, and strict-equality compile-negative tests.
requiredBenchmark: Allocation audit confirms validation wrappers do not enter hot vector loops.
entries.provenFallback: Final validation functions returning an explicit Either stable-error ADT.
assumptions: Opaque types remain limited to validation boundaries.

entries.claim: The Scala 3 optimizer can be evaluated through frozen Profile B and own-source-only Profile C after independent correctness qualification.
entries.problemRelevance: May reduce pure numeric kernel overhead while preserving the same neutral contract.
entries.correctnessRisk: Inlining scope or optimizer behavior can alter floating evaluation or introduce unresolved dependency warnings.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Exact Scala 3.8.4 flags are qualification-smoked; dependency-wide inlining is forbidden.
requiredLint: Exact options, own-source inline scope, warning-free compilation, and no forbidden optimization.
requiredTests: A, B, and C each rerun unit, property, stable-error, oracle, and cross-language matrices with mismatch zero.
requiredBenchmark: Frozen seven-case three-rotation JMH profile selector only.
entries.provenFallback: Profile A with no optimizer options.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Public Scala project article and compiler documentation.
assumptions: No profile is selected from the full scored benchmark.

entries.claim: Local implementation mutation may be hidden behind an observationally pure function only when a frozen ledger and evidence justify it.
entries.problemRelevance: Primitive arrays and loops may reduce allocation in selected large numeric kernels.
entries.correctnessRisk: Mutation can escape, alter inputs, change traversal order, or hide stale allowlist entries.
entries.toolingCompatibility: The source-policy checker supports exact file, method, symbol, reason, test, owner, and expiry entries.
requiredLint: Mutation is rejected outside the precommitted exact ledger and stale entries fail.
requiredTests: Input digest immutability, bounds, property, and full parity tests.
requiredBenchmark: Allocation evidence and focused JMH improvement under the frozen selector.
entries.provenFallback: Immutable collection operations and ordinary pure folds.
assumptions: The Gate 1 mutation allowlist starts empty.

entries.claim: Safe initialization remains an experimental advisory compiler diagnostic in this scored lane.
entries.problemRelevance: Can reveal initialization hazards without changing the stable hard compiler profile.
entries.correctnessRisk: Treating an experimental checker as a stable gate could make the benchmark subject depend on unstable diagnostics.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Run separately from the frozen stable warning set.
requiredLint: Record every warning and disposition without suppression.
requiredTests: Advisory compile result is typed and excluded from correctness semantics.
entries.provenFallback: The frozen stable hard-warning profile without -Wsafe-init.
assumptions: Advisory diagnostics do not alter candidate source after timing starts.

entries.claim: Preview, nightly, capture checking, explicit nulls, runtimeChecked, macros, native loading, fast math, FMA, and architecture-native SIMD are outside the scored contract.
entries.problemRelevance: These features could change portability, auditability, or IEEE-754 parity.
entries.correctnessRisk: High and difficult to isolate across Scala, Haskell, and the frozen Python oracle.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Rejected by source and options policy before compilation or timing.
requiredLint: Exact forbidden symbol, import, dependency, and compiler-option scan.
requiredTests: Qualified, aliased, annotation, dependency, and option negative fixtures.
entries.provenFallback: Stable Scala 3.8.4 language, scalar Double operations, and portable JVM bytecode.
assumptions: Auditability and cross-language parity outrank feature novelty.

entries.claim: Vector-free scalar validation and ADT modules compile with mandatory Safe while retaining separate purity and behavior audits.
entries.problemRelevance: Narrows trusted dependencies at stable error and scalar validation boundaries.
entries.correctnessRisk: Safe Haskell alone does not prove totality, numerical correctness, or I/O separation.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Qualified under authoritative GHC 9.10.3 with exact negative compile fixtures.
requiredLint: Mandatory Safe, explicit import/export, hard warnings, and no unsafe, foreign, exception, or partial symbol.
requiredTests: Category manifest, compiler negative fixtures, totality properties, and process behavior.
requiredBenchmark: No independent speed claim; included in selected authoritative subject.
entries.provenFallback: No weaker Trustworthy mode; incompatible trusted dependencies are a blocker.

entries.claim: Pure numeric arrays use vector 0.13.2.0 Data.Vector.Unboxed and are classified audited-pure-vector because the upstream module has Safe Haskell status None.
entries.problemRelevance: Provides contiguous unboxed Double storage for pure numeric kernels.
entries.correctnessRisk: A Trustworthy wrapper would falsely imply upstream Safe Haskell guarantees and could hide transitive unsafe edges.
entries.toolingCompatibility: LTS 24.50 pins vector 0.13.2.0; module and dependency audits are precommitted.
requiredLint: Reject candidate Trustworthy or Unsafe declarations, direct unsafe and foreign imports, IO use, and core-to-shell edges.
requiredTests: Exact module category, source-hash provenance, totality, property, process, and upstream edge drift tests.
requiredBenchmark: Included in baseline and optimized Criterion qualification and selected subject.
entries.provenFallback: Ordinary immutable U.Vector and U.foldl' without mutable vector or unsafe wrappers.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Public Hackage API documentation; package license is audited through the pinned dependency plan.
assumptions: Gate 2 records the exact source archive hash before acceptance.

entries.claim: runST and mutable unboxed vectors may be adopted only when mutation cannot escape and frozen correctness, allocation, Core, and Criterion evidence all pass.
entries.problemRelevance: May reduce allocation in a proven numeric hot kernel while retaining a pure public result.
entries.correctnessRisk: Escape, traversal-order drift, bounds errors, or a timing-driven implementation switch would invalidate parity.
entries.toolingCompatibility: The audited-pure-vector category and exact policy ledger can inspect the implementation.
requiredLint: Exact module and symbol ledger, no escape, no unsafe import, and no stale entry.
requiredTests: Bounds, input immutability, full unit/property/error/oracle/cross matrix with mismatch zero.
requiredBenchmark: Allocation and Core evidence plus focused frozen Criterion qualification.
assumptions: Conditional optimization is selected before the full score benchmark.

entries.claim: GHC 9.14.1 is a required latest-stable non-scoring compatibility lane while LTS 24.50 and GHC 9.10.3 remain authoritative.
entries.problemRelevance: Separates current compiler compatibility from the tested-together authoritative Stackage package set.
entries.correctnessRisk: Changing non-boot dependencies to make the latest compiler pass would confound compiler and package effects.
entries.toolingCompatibility: The compatibility policy freezes non-boot equality, expected boot-set difference, result enum, phase closure, and non-scoring status.
requiredLint: Forbidden override keys absent and authoritative-versus-compat non-boot plans byte-equivalent.
requiredTests: Dependency build is mandatory; successful solve requires full correctness and process replay; failures require typed classification.
requiredBenchmark: performanceInput is false and timing cannot enter scorecard numerator, denominator, or rank.
entries.provenFallback: Retain authoritative LTS 24.50 and GHC 9.10.3; only narrowly proven frozen-dependency failure is non-blocking.
assumptions: The compatibility lane uses identical candidate source and approved non-boot flags.
